assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's one curated REVIEWED item at basis_commit: KIMISHINU_MIMI_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md (86,307 bytes, status canonical, veto false), a character monograph of Gagari Mimi over Japanese manga V01-V09, the V02/V04/V07 drawn bonuses, the V03 in-volume extra, the V05 special booklet, the V08 in-volume supplements and Side Stories SS01-SS06, built from the five V09+SIDE_STORIES ledgers. Read in full by the evaluator. The ledgers, sequential readings and the Sheena-Mimi relationship synthesis are not curated on this subject and were not used. The item's simulation_ready label is an input, not a conclusion; the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Integrated boundary V09+SIDE_STORIES, with the item's chronology states (section 20) split at located changes: pre-V01 underground secret-weapon period (undated); V01 (CH01-CH05: category switch, pain and fear, maternal-scent cue); V02-V03 (CH06-CH07 first friendship and resurrection secret, CH10 return destination, CH11 failed no-injury return, CH14 Seiran's death); V04 (CH15-CH16 first bereavement, CH17-CH18 absence search, CH19 reciprocal right to protect); V05 (CH21 protective-substitution motive, CH20-CH23 quarrel and repair, concealment dominant until then); V06 (CH26 first transparent wounded return, CH28 memory erosion, forgetting fear and the non-magical kiss before any mutual label); V07 (CH32-CH34 jealousy, CH34 mutual lovers); V08 (CH35 public couplehood and boundary deference, CH38 fixed-body asymmetry); V09 (CH40 underground history and rejection of mother equivalence, CH41 strategic allocation, CH42 uncertain graduation). Her resurrection, her mother and her underground history are her memories at every state; only the reader's access to them dates from V02, V06 and V09.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution); evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: A stated architecture (section 4: concrete immediacy, low inhibition, real pain and fear with weak veto, protective substitution, action-first attachment, care that becomes control under attachment threat, replacement sensitivity, memory vulnerability), about twenty dynamic state variables (6.2) and twenty conditional response policies with confidence and chronology (MPOL-01 to MPOL-20). Recoverability is named as the hinge of her risk arithmetic (section 18 step 3), so the response changes with whether she, or the other person, can come back. It predicts her mistakes: disproportionate care for a minor scrape, concealment of injuries before V05 (V03 CH11, V05 CH20-CH21), restriction of Sheena when danger looks avoidable (V05 CH20-CH23), and jealousy surveillance (V07 CH32-CH34). Not A: whether love has lowered her battlefield self-risk is explicitly open (7.1, 15.11), and the frozen diagnostic tests (section 23) are untested. Not C: responses are discriminated by recoverability, by who is at risk, by relationship state and by chronology, and the item says where the account stops (sections 17 and 22 OPEN).

Chronology states from pre-V01 to V09+SIDE_STORIES (section 20) with chapter-located transitions (sections 5 and 21) and explicit prospective discipline (section 1): no confirmed resurrection at V01, no authored fighting motive before V05 CH21, no transparent return before V06 CH26, no lover status before V07 CH34, bodily stasis explicit only at V08 CH38. MPOL-06 (concealment, historical) and MPOL-07 (transparent return, current) are split at the V05 repair. Not A: the pre-V01 period is undated by the item's own rule (5.1), and Side-Story placements are summarized. Not C: state changes are located and earlier uncertainty is preserved.

A Japanese voice model conditioned by recipient and state (section 10): third-person self-reference `ミミ` (6.1, 10.1), short declaratives, direct wants and questions, attention-getting repetition (`ねーねー`-type), playful elongation and low hedging; identity anchor `ミミはミミだよ`; repeated `シーナ` and return language with Sheena; familiar, teasing, non-deferential register with Fran; enumerating, trailing-off jealousy voice; `why` questions and reversal-seeking in first grief; sensory memory-fear vocabulary; romance in `好き`, `大好き`, `特別`, `一人`, `恋人` and the diary line `シーナと恋人になった` (V07). Negative constraints are explicit (10.13), and the idiolect stays childlike as the romance deepens (failure mode 20). Not A: few lines are quoted, and there is no sentence-final or address-term inventory beyond the self-reference and name repetition. Not C: the register rules change with recipient and state, and the item gives the first-person form.

Ordinary life is modeled as a developmental frontier with high novelty value (4.6): hunger, sleepiness, food requests, baths, roommate life, flowers and the flower crown (V03), cooking, diaries, hair care, and the Side Story `きらきら`, where doing almost nothing together is relationship life. Approach behavior gives a usable rule: she moves toward wanted food, touch and people (4.2). Not B: the activities are listed rather than located scene by scene, and routine away from Sheena is thin. Not D: stated rules with located nodes (V01 CH01, V02 CH07-CH08, Side Stories).

Partner-specific accounts (section 7): Sheena (first friend, return target and lover, with the mature rule in 7.1 and the role-differentiated aftercare solution in 4.10 and MPOL-14); Fran (familiar caretaker and manager of the confinement cycle, teased and relied on); Ari (grief recipient whose refusal of resurrection shows Mimi another person's autonomy, V04 CH15-CH16); Haru (nonjudgment by fit and choice, 7.4); the peer cohort (gratitude, reliance and dehumanization at once, 7.5); Seiran (motive mirror, V03 CH13-CH14). Not A: Haru and the peer cohort are single-pattern accounts without chapter locators, and betrayal by Sheena is untested (17.9). Not C: the response policy changes with the partner, and those changes are located.

Located inner states: pain, cold and fading consciousness under catastrophic injury (V01 CH04-CH05), inability to name sadness after Seiran's death (V04), fear of forgetting Sheena's voice, eye color and warmth (V06 CH28), replacement fear (V07), lover-specific insecurity about the fixed body (V08 CH38). The item states that attachment shows in action before explanation (4.7), so inner states are tied to conduct. Not A: her stance toward killing beyond operational normalization is open (17.11), and pre-V01 inner history is fragmentary. Not C: inner states are located and linked to behavior.

Interpersonal conflict is modeled (section 9): triggers, an escalation repertoire (direct requests, monitoring, name repetition, tears, immediate fixes) with a less-likely list, the V05 repair lesson that disagreement need not end attachment, the jealousy repair path, and an out-of-character list (9.5). Not A: two templates carry the account (the V05 quarrel and V07 jealousy), and battlefield tactics are not modeled at decision level, only competence and the substitution bias. Not C: the conditions that escalate and repair conflict are explicit and located.

Concrete morality traced across the arc (section 12): fighting as good because it helps, the authored substitution motive (V05 CH21), reciprocal non-disposability demanded for Sheena (V04 CH19) while not applied to herself (12.4), agency learned after V05 and applied at V08 CH35, and the Ari resurrection offer as reversal-seeking before grief competence. The account explains why her conduct changes: recoverability, who is at risk, whether the loved person chose the danger. Not A: her personal stance toward killing and any political or institutional position are open or absent (13.3, 17.5, 17.11). Not C: positions change at located points, with reasons.

Only brief mentions: playful elongation and liveliness (10.1-10.2) and teasing Fran (7.2, 10.10). No humor scene is located or analyzed. Not D: there is no distributed account of play. Not NOT_ASSESSED: the item does affirm playfulness as part of her baseline register.

One canonical monograph over the full current-publication boundary with a chapter-level evidence spine (section 21). Not B: only this item is curated; the spine is explicitly not an exhaustive locator index, and the ledgers, readings and Sheena-Mimi synthesis are not on the row. Not D: coverage spans every volume and supplement with located nodes.

Affirmative contradictions with their source: pain and fear are explicit (V01 CH04-CH05) against the painless reading; she rejects mother equivalence (V09 CH40); the growth medicine is camouflage, not maturation (V08 CH38); jealousy is explicit after lover status (V07); diary as deliberate anti-forgetting program is unconfirmed (sections 3.2, 16 and 22 REJECT). Not A: none is tested against held-out source. Not C: the contradictions are located and scoped.

Prospective discipline is explicit (section 1), the chronology states keep earlier uncertainty (section 20), and transitions carry chapter locators (section 21). Not A: Side-Story routing is summarized, the pre-V01 period is undated, and some transitions span chapter ranges. Not C: most state claims are dated and located.

conditions: Illustrative lines only, at a declared state, never presented as quotation or as imitation of Japanese beyond the quoted anchors.
Third-person `ミミ`, short direct wants and questions, repetition under emotion and concrete person or body words; love terms (`特別`, `恋人`) only from V07 CH34.
No philosophical, clinical, strategic, political or ornate romantic language (10.13); no sentence-final, address-term or acoustic claims beyond the self-reference and name repetition.
scenario_readiness.note: Recipient- and state-conditioned register rules and a stated self-reference constrain illustrative output; the quoted surface is thin.

conditions: Chronology is one named state from the item's table (section 20), defaulting to V09+SIDE_STORIES; pre-V05 states conceal injuries from Sheena, pre-V06 states have no transparent return, and pre-V07 states have no lover status.
The interlocutor is Sheena, Fran, Ari or a member of the peer cohort, or Haru for a harmless self-chosen presentation. An unsampled student or adult is a separate, lower-confidence condition.

Resolve in the item's order (section 18): the concrete situation, Sheena's involvement, recoverability, substitution versus control, relationship security, institutional constraint, action before explanation, voice, state update.
A clean tactical choice in which a safer tactic also succeeds is output as an open fork with the protective-substitution bias as default, never as love-driven caution (7.1, section 23 test 1).
Loss of restoration, life after Sheena, peacetime, command of others, political argument and betrayal by Sheena are output as open forks or declined (section 17).

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state from pre-V01 to V09+SIDE_STORIES, defaulting to V09+SIDE_STORIES; no events after V09. Her resurrection, her mother and her underground history are her memories at every state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Sheena as first friend, then lover from V07 CH34; Fran as caretaker and institutional manager; Ari as grieving peer; the peer cohort as classmates who rely on her; Haru for presentation-choice scenes only; an unsampled student or adult only at lower confidence.
setting_constraints: The militarized school, dormitory, infirmary and deployment-and-return cycle, or a comparable institution where she holds no authority
No command role, peacetime, adult legal status or political setting
Named open questions end in an open fork

scenario_readiness.note: Bounded counterfactuals inside the school-and-deployment institution with sampled interlocutors.

conditions: Domestic and ordinary scenes with Sheena (meals, sleep, baths, hair care, cooking, flowers, doing nothing together) and familiar teasing with Fran.
Direct requests for food, touch and attention, and low embarrassment about closeness; public lover announcements after V07 without a change of idiolect (V08 CH35).
Exact activities and wording stay open; unsampled acquaintances are a separate, lower-confidence condition.
scenario_readiness.note: Supported for routine with Sheena and familiar scenes with Fran.

conditions: Questions of who dies, who can come back, who gets hurt and who is waiting: substitution of her recoverable body for mortal peers, reciprocal protection, a loved person's chosen risk, irreversible loss.
Output concrete person-level reasoning, never doctrine; she may insist others are not disposable while still volunteering herself (12.4).
No political, strategic or institutional-reform positions, and no worked-out stance on killing (13.3, 17.11).
scenario_readiness.note: Located positions support substitution, reciprocity and agency questions.

conditions: Sheena only. V01: maternal-scent approach cue, not romance; V06 CH28: the non-magical kiss accepted before any mutual label; from V07 CH34: mutual lovers.
One-person specialness without demanding Sheena's isolation; jealousy by concrete enumeration, then reassurance and relationship-specific aftercare; fixed-body insecurity from V08 CH38.
No other partner and no sexual extrapolation beyond the manga (17.10).
scenario_readiness.note: Supported for the Sheena relationship only, split at located states.

conditions: Her deployment role as the school's recoverable combatant: volunteering for disproportionate danger, return priority to Sheena, and transparent wounded return from V06 CH26.
Tactical choices are predicted only at the level of the substitution bias; exact tactics, command and allocation of other people's lives are outside the evidence (17.6).
Institutional constraint is real: she is summoned and allocated (V09 CH41) and does not set her own deployments.
scenario_readiness.note: Read as her deployment-and-return role; command and tactical detail are outside the evidence.

known_limits.statement: Whether love and future orientation have lowered her battlefield self-risk is explicitly open through V09; the item forbids predicting love-driven caution.
Her risk calculus depends on recoverability; behavior if restoration became unavailable cannot be predicted safely.
Her personal moral stance toward killing beyond operational normalization is not shown.
There is little evidence for political reasoning, institutional leadership or command over others.
Life after Sheena, peacetime, graduation and legal adulthood are unknown; the source establishes only the fear and the uncertainty.
External memory anchors exist, but a deliberate anti-forgetting program is unconfirmed.
The timing of her death and resurrection, her custody and the length of the underground period are not established and must not be invented.
The Haru and peer-cohort accounts are single patterns without chapter locators in the item.
Few lines are quoted, and no sentence-final or address-term inventory is given beyond the self-reference `ミミ` and name repetition.
Play and humor are mentioned but not analyzed or located.
The frozen future-release diagnostic predictions have not been tested against a later volume.
